scope: Candidate reference points for registering pre-camp photographs and plans of the ground north of Tell es-Sultan. Every candidate is named in the repository with a source. None has a surveyed target-frame coordinate yet.

roles.control: May be used in the fit.
roles.check: Eligible as the withheld check point.
roles.tie: Ties two historical documents to each other; not a control in the modern frame unless it still exists.
roles.line_check: A line feature: checks scale or orientation, never a point control.
roles.date_marker: Dates the document; never a control.
roles.anchor: A bearing origin for the north-sector relation; never a control.
roles.exclude: Not usable in a planar fit.

candidates.feature: ʿAin es-Sultan spring: curved spring-house wall and the curved north end of the 1898 reservoir
candidates.point: Northernmost point of the inner face of the curved north end
candidates.documents: pre-1890 photos (wall only); 1908 plan; 1918 aerials; 1945 RAF; 1954; modern
candidates.stability: Wall pre-1745; reservoir back wall since 1898, about 1 m east of the old wall and on the same curve. Do not use the post-1911 sluice wall.

candidates.feature: Tell es-Sultan, east foot beside the spring
candidates.sources: Kenyon III Fig. 1 p. xxv (composite plan 1907–1958, metric scale); BS Pal. 1031
candidates.point: Break of slope where the mound meets the plain, on the line through the spring
candidates.stability: Erosion and spoil change the foot; a break of slope is fuzzy.

candidates.sources: Kenyon III Fig. 1 p. xxv; BS Pal. 1031
candidates.point: Break of slope on the west side, on the east–west line through the WBADB point
candidates.stability: Kenyon's Trench I cuts the west side after 1952.

candidates.sources: Kenyon III Fig. 1 p. xxv; BS Pal. 1031
candidates.point: Break of slope on the south side, on the north–south line through the WBADB point
candidates.stability: Fuzzy; later trenches on the south.

candidates.sources: Kenyon III frontispiece (northern terrace is a 1930–36 dump); Kenyon II p. 169
candidates.point: Break of slope on the north side
candidates.stability: Buried by the 1930–36 dump; it borders the target strip.

candidates.feature: Sellin–Watzinger trenches of 1907–09 on the tell
candidates.sources: BS Pal. 1031 catalogue note; Kenyon III Fig. 1 p. xxv
candidates.documents: 1908 to the next excavation that cut them
candidates.stability: Later excavations may have removed them.

candidates.feature: Kenyon Trenches I–III (1952–58), including Trench II/Site O at the north end
candidates.sources: Kenyon III Fig. 1 p. xxv; Trench II local frame (states-kenyon-trench-II)
candidates.stability: Still visible on site (inference); absent from every pre-camp record.

candidates.feature: Northern terrace dump of the 1930–36 excavations
candidates.stability: Its presence dates a document after 1930.

candidates.sources: Kenyon II pp. 539–544 (N.S.1 lies toward Kh. Mefjar), via follow-up C
candidates.point: A defined masonry corner after excavation; the mound centre before
candidates.stability: Masonry corners are stable once exposed; a mound centre is ±10–20 m.

candidates.sources: Kenyon II p. 165 (plateau ends at the wadi, 1150 m north of the tell); BS Pal. 1032 and 1020/a titles
BS Pal. 1031 and 1032 archive titles; W2G report (a walled compound NW of the tell, possibly the mills: inference)
candidates.point: A masonry corner, after its identity is confirmed on a named plan

candidates.stability: Position relative to the tell is not recorded in the repository.

candidates.sources: BS Pal. 1031 archive title; WBADB S2430
candidates.stability: About 0.9 km SSW of the tell point.

candidates.sources: BS Pal. 1031 description; CORONA DF041 (two roads in 1967)
candidates.point: A junction, only if the same alignment is shown in both documents

candidates.sources: Kenyon I Fig. 1 p. xxii (1956 settlement); Kenyon II Figs 14 p. 35, 91 p. 168; CORONA DF041

candidates.stability: Relief displacement on verticals; orientation check only.
